Then launch at reduced frequency rather than all 5,000 flights at once, prove the load factor and fare, and scale up as actuals confirm the estimates. And phase the exits so you're not stranded if the new routes underperform — keep optionality on the aircraft. Essentially, treat the estimate as a hypothesis to test, not a fact to bet the recovery on.
